card.name: Third digit of years in dates
card.fires_on: The third digit of a four-digit year after a leading 1, mostly 8 or 9, as in 1800s and 1900s birth years, publication dates and event years in biographical or historical text.

modes.label: Birth and death years
modes.description: The digit after '1' in a life-span in parentheses next to a person's name.

modes.label: Event or publication year
modes.description: The digit after '1' in a year giving when a work, award or event happened.
